Peeters 2002 gives distance-one A_1 and mod-p operator calculations; rank of A_3 cannot be inferred merely from rank of A_1 because rank of a polynomial in a nonsemisimple operator is not determined by the rank of the operator alone.

value.rationale: Natural third Hamming shell of the binary n-cube supports a dense mod-two graph update whose full state transition diagram changes across four congruence classes. Two nilpotent phases have distinctly sized exceptional homology captured by a nontrivial characteristic-two alternating-form tensor calculation. The exact four-class rank law resolves a motivated infinite-family invariant and supplies every initial transient layer and recurrent period count; not merely one finite example or a parameter rename.
